metadata.database: A Deeper China | Beijing point decision layer

BJ001.guest_value: Give one bounded encounter with imperial spatial order.
BJ001.choose_rule: Choose the reading question and scope before confirming entry.
BJ001.stop_after: One spatial or political idea is understood; do not consume every hall.

BJ002.guest_value: Provide a short elevation reset and a city-scale view after the Palace Museum.
BJ002.choose_rule: Add only if heat, mobility and queue load still make the contrast worthwhile.
BJ002.stop_after: The city axis is legible from above; do not turn it into a second monument.

BJ003.guest_value: Show the civic-scale counterpart to the imperial axis.
BJ003.choose_rule: Treat access, screening and identity as a planned segment, not a casual add-on.
BJ003.stop_after: The civic scale has been understood without extending into a checklist.

BJ004.guest_value: Connect imperial ritual architecture with public park life.
BJ004.choose_rule: Use as the main ritual/park question and verify interior-site rules separately.
BJ004.stop_after: The guest can distinguish ritual space from everyday park use.

BJ005.guest_value: Move from monumental order to commerce, streets and adaptive reuse.
BJ005.choose_rule: Select by the guest’s food, urban-history or design question; do not call it authentic by default.
BJ005.stop_after: The transition from civic axis to commercial street is clear.

BJ006.guest_value: Introduce the historic city as a system organised by time and axis.
BJ006.choose_rule: Use current official hours and offer a ground-level alternative if stairs are unsuitable.
BJ006.stop_after: The time/axis question is answered without turning the tower into a must-climb.

BJ007.guest_value: Connect water, lanes and former residences without reducing hutongs to one photo street.
BJ007.choose_rule: Build by time of day and public routes; private homes are not attractions.
BJ007.stop_after: One neighbourhood pattern is legible and resident privacy remains intact.

BJ008.guest_value: Make the famous-lane trade-off explicit for a short first visit.
BJ008.choose_rule: Choose only if the visitor values recognition or shopping over quiet observation.
BJ008.stop_after: The guest has decided whether the famous lane serves the actual brief.

BJ009.guest_value: Offer a smaller-scale evening neighbourhood possibility for repeat visitors.
BJ009.choose_rule: Never promise a particular venue; use only after current field walk and return check.
BJ009.stop_after: The street mood fits; do not turn it into a late-night venue crawl.

BJ010.guest_value: Offer a Wall day with scenery, preserved fabric and ascent/return choices.
BJ010.choose_rule: Select only after fitness, weather, transfer and cable-car/return questions are answered.
BJ010.stop_after: The planned section, turnaround and return are verified.

BJ011.guest_value: Compare Wall sections by access, recognition, scenery and physical cost.
BJ011.choose_rule: Present verified options; do not use a universal best ranking.
BJ011.stop_after: The visitor has selected one section with a real return plan.

BJ012.guest_value: Contrast ceremonial axis with water, distance and imperial retreat.
BJ012.choose_rule: Use only when the visitor has energy for a large site and wants landscape.
BJ012.stop_after: The spatial contrast is clear; do not stack another imperial site.

BJ013.guest_value: Offer a central water-and-garden reset without a full Summer Palace day.
BJ013.choose_rule: Use as a pacing component, not a compulsory landmark.
BJ013.stop_after: The guest has recovered and understood the water/public-life contrast.

BJ014.guest_value: Give a concrete entry into current Beijing cultural production in an industrial setting.
BJ014.choose_rule: Match the district to a current exhibition-led half-day; entry is not the same as free exhibition access.
BJ014.stop_after: One programme answers the art/design question.

BJ015.guest_value: Potentially extend contemporary art beyond the most legible district.
BJ015.choose_rule: Do not include until programme, transport and venue continuity are current.
BJ015.stop_after: The selected venue adds a genuine new question; otherwise omit it.

BJ016.guest_value: Protect the first 24 hours from payment, data, identity and jet-lag failures.
BJ016.choose_rule: Build from actual airport, arrival time, hotel and next-day reservation.
BJ016.stop_after: The guest is connected, paid, oriented and rested enough for the next anchor.

BJ017.guest_value: Prevent an attractive route from failing at the first named-entry gate.
BJ017.choose_rule: Use official current channels and deadlines; never claim availability.
BJ017.stop_after: The critical reservation/identity sequence is understood and assigned to the traveller.

BJ018.guest_value: Give independent visitors a current payment and transit fallback.
BJ018.choose_rule: Offer official options plus contingency; do not promise every merchant accepts one method.
BJ018.stop_after: The visitor can make the first necessary payment and move to the next route.

BJ019.guest_value: Provide a three-day skeleton with one imperial, one Wall and one interest-led day.
BJ019.choose_rule: Use as a structure, not a fixed schedule; limit anchors and preserve recovery.
BJ019.stop_after: The guest has a coherent three-day shape with reservation order understood.

BJ020.guest_value: Use five days for garden/water, deeper hutong and contemporary layers rather than more monuments.
BJ020.choose_rule: Only use when five full days are real; more sights are not automatically more depth.
BJ020.stop_after: Each extra day adds a different question and a realistic recovery window.
